Peakhealth AI Inc

Full Stack Developer (Stealth Startup, Remote - US based)

Full Stack Developer (Stealth Startup, Remote - US based)

The Mission: We’re rebuilding healthcare to keep people well. The American system is broken—built to treat illness, not prevent it.

The Team: Led by a repeat healthcare founder (incl. 2x unicorns/1x IPO), you will be joining a team of top clinical, tech and AI talent - including a four-time New York Times bestselling Chief Medical Officer (a world-renowned endocrinologist) and other leading experts in medicine, machine learning, and healthcare commercialization.

What we do: PeakHealth is creating a new care delivery platform that integrates comprehensive women’s health, longevity care, and functional medicine into everyday primary care.

Role: Own and ship full-stack features end-to-end—from patient dashboards to backend logic. Work closely with design, product, and clinical ops to rapidly build and iterate.

You bring: 3+ years experience; strong with React, Node, and Python. Familiar with common LLM stacks. Experience building APIs, scalable infra, and secure systems. Bonus: health-tech or HIPAA exposure.

Comp: Competitive

Location: Remote (US-based)
